title: SYNTHETIC: Northstar Pumps supplier note
body: Northstar Pumps purchases precision valves from Acme Components. The supply relationship is described here solely for a synthetic software test.

title: SYNTHETIC: Acme Components plant interruption

title: SYNTHETIC: unrelated logistics update

title: SYNTHETIC: later follow-up not yet available at the sample cutoff
